themes.name: Modern Light
themes.description: Best for general-purpose presentations, startups, product demos, research, education, technology, and professional topics. Clean, light design with blue accents and Inter typography.

themes.name: Modern Dark
themes.description: Best for technology, software, AI, engineering, developer tools, product launches, and modern business presentations. Vibrant dark design with blue/indigo accents and Inter typography.

themes.name: Corporate
themes.description: Best for business, finance, consulting, sales, marketing, enterprise reports, strategy, and executive presentations. Professional light design with slate/sky blue accents and Roboto typography.

themes.name: Creative
themes.description: Best for design portfolios, branding, advertising, media, art, fashion, creative agencies, and innovation pitches. Colorful pink/rose background with deep violet accents and Outfit typography.

themes.name: Elegant
themes.description: Best for literature, history, culture, architecture, academic presentations, ceremonies, and refined storytelling. Sophisticated warm grey design with Merriweather headings and Inter body.

themes.name: Playful
themes.description: Best for children's education, school projects, games, entertainment, fun events, workshops, and lighthearted presentations. Fun, warm yellow design with orange accents and Quicksand typography.

themes.name: Nature
themes.description: Best for nature, wildlife, environment, sustainability, agriculture, climate, ecology, travel, and outdoor topics. Calming earthy green and cream design with Lora headings and Inter body.

themes.name: Sunset
themes.description: Best for travel, lifestyle, wellness, hospitality, food, tourism, inspirational talks, and personal storytelling. Warm orange/clay peach design with Outfit/Inter typography.

themes.name: Ocean
themes.description: Best for marine science, water conservation, healthcare, biotechnology, clean energy, environmental studies, and calming professional presentations. Fresh sea breeze blue design with Outfit/Inter typography.

themes.name: Minimalist
themes.description: Best for research papers, academic conferences, technical documentation, architecture, product design, and presentations requiring maximum clarity. Stark monochrome black & white design with Playfair Display/Inter typography.

themes.name: Lavender
themes.description: Best for healthcare, psychology, education, women-focused initiatives, wellness, startups, modern products, and creative business presentations. Modern lavender geometric design with Poppins typography.

themes.name: Dracula
themes.description: Best for AI, cybersecurity, programming, gaming, blockchain, software engineering, hacking, developer conferences, and futuristic technology presentations. Dark aesthetic featuring deep purples, pastel pinks, and neon mauve highlights.

themes.name: Nord Dark
themes.description: Best for cloud computing, DevOps, engineering, open-source projects, infrastructure, data science, technical documentation, and developer presentations. Clean arctic-inspired dark slate theme with icy blue highlights and crisp layout.

themes.name: Forest Dark
themes.description: Best for sustainability, conservation, forestry, agriculture, biodiversity, environmental research, renewable energy, and eco-friendly initiatives. Restorative deep forest green theme with mint green and soft sage accents.

themes.name: Luxury Dark
themes.description: Best for premium brands, luxury products, high-end real estate, fashion, jewelry, executive presentations, exclusive services, and investor pitches. Sophisticated obsidian black theme with elegant gold, bronze details and serif typography.

slideTypes.name: Standard Slide
slideTypes.description: Standard slide where blocks stack vertically.

slideTypes.name: Split Left Image
slideTypes.description: Left image, right content area. Requires 'image' string and 'imageSize' number (percentage 25-75).

slideTypes.name: Split Right Image
slideTypes.description: Right image, left content area. Requires 'image' string and 'imageSize' number (percentage 25-75).

slideTypes.name: Top Image Banner
slideTypes.description: Top image banner. Requires 'image' string and 'imageSize' number (height percentage 20 - 30).

slideTypes.name: Full Image
slideTypes.description: Full bleed background image. NO blocks allowed in this slide type.

bullets.name: Bullet Points
bullets.description: Standard lists or grids containing multiple sequential headers and descriptions.

types.name: Simple List
types.description: A classic vertical list of items, splitting into a 2-column layout when there are more than 4 items. Best for general text outlines and comprehensive summaries.

types.name: Bullets Grid
types.description: A structured grid of bullet items with headers and descriptions. Best for comparisons or scanning multiple parallel points at a glance.

types.name: Numbered List
types.description: A sequential list with prominent numbers instead of basic bullets. Best for step-by-step processes or top N lists. 2 columns recomended

types.name: Accent Bullets
types.description: A refined list where items are highlighted with horizontal accent bars. 2columns recommended

cards.name: Card Layouts
cards.description: Grid or block cards to visually separate and present group data.

types.name: Basic Cards
types.description: Clean border-based card grid for showcasing features or items side-by-side cleanly.

types.name: Outline Cards
types.description: Stylish card layout with subtle top accent bars and outlined borders. Best for highlight lists or structured features.

types.name: Numbered Cards
types.description: Card grid featuring prominent step/sequence numbers in each card header. Best for multi-step processes, key takeaways, phases, or numbered feature sets.

types.name: Accent Cards
types.description: Card layout with distinct header banner backgrounds and clean accent divider lines. Best for grouping distinct concepts, categorized topics, or highlighted features.

icons.name: Icon Layouts
icons.description: Visual layouts featuring prominent icons to represent concepts.

types.name: Icons List
types.description: A vertical list of items prominently featuring an icon on the left. Best for detailing specific features or steps.

types.name: Icons Grid
types.description: A structured grid of items prominently featuring a large icon for each. Best for visualizing abstract features or high-level business capabilities.

types.name: Icons Card
types.description: A structured grid of items prominently featuring a large icon for each. Best for visualizing abstract features or high-level business capabilities.

stats.name: Key Metrics & Statistics
stats.description: Large text indicators highlighting critical figures or metrics.

types.name: Stat Highlight
types.description: Emphasizes a single massive key metric with a detailed text callout description. Best for highlighting a monumental breakthrough metric. This must be used in normal slide, with this as the only block along with slide level header block. header block is optional here.

types.name: Stats Grid
types.description: Grid display of big numbers and their descriptions. Best for dashboard summaries and showing multiple performance KPIs at once. Use only one item in header field.

timelines.name: Timeline Layouts
timelines.description: Visual horizontal and vertical timeline tracks to represent milestones, project phases, or sequential stages.

types.name: Vertical Timeline
types.description: A vertical timeline track with nodes alternating left and right, complete with connector lines.

types.name: Horizontal Timeline
types.description: A horizontal timeline track with nodes alternating top and bottom, perfect for broad horizontal milestones.

types.name: Chevron Timeline
types.description: A horizontal sequence of connected chevron arrows with description text alternating top and bottom.

basic.name: Basic Blocks
basic.description: Essential structural blocks like text, images, tables, and code snippets.

types.name: Large Text
types.description: Large text perfect for main slide titles or big statements.

types.name: Plain Text
types.description: A clean, simple text paragraph layout for long-form descriptions or quotes.

types.name: Single Image
types.description: A single prominent image occupying maximum space, suitable for high-impact visual slides.

types.name: Image Gallery
types.description: A dynamic grid gallery displaying multiple images beautifully.

types.name: Table
types.description: A flexible table layout. The block MUST include 'tableColumns' array (e.g., [{id: 'col1', label: 'Header 1', width: 1}, {id: 'col2', label: 'Header 2', width: 2}]). Each item MUST include a 'cells' object mapping column IDs to text (e.g., {cells: {col1: 'Data 1', col2: 'Data 2'}}). 2 - 5 columns and 4 - 8 rows are recommended

types.name: Code Block
types.description: A preformatted code block for displaying source code.
